title: AFC President Endorses Infantino for Fourth Term as FIFA President
text: AFC President Endorses Infantino for Fourth Term as FIFA President Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa, the head of the Asian Football Confederation, announced on Friday that the AFC is endorsing Gianni Infantino for a fourth term as FIFA president. With 47 member associations, the AFC bloc holds significant voting power that could secure Infantino's re-election in March. The endorsement was made at an extraordinary congress, and no other candidates have filed to challenge Infantino ahead of the November 18 deadline. TOKYO — The head of the Asian Football Confederation said Friday the body is endorsing Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president. It would be Infantino's fourth term. The AFC has 47 member confederations and, even if all the members do not follow the direction of Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa, the AFC president, those votes could be a key to guaranteeing another mandate for Infantino, who leads the governing body of world soccer. The FIFA election is in March and the deadline for candidates to file against Infantino is Nov. 18. So for none has filed.Sheikh Salman, speaking at the body's extraordinary congress meeting on Friday, embraced Infantino and said in front of the membership and as he delivered his endorsement.“We affirm our full commitment to supporting you and your leadership as you seek a new mandate as the FIFA president. ” Sheikh Salman said.“You’ve visited a lot of countries in Asia. I’ve spoken to a lot of members within this continent.
